translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús-e-urbamar, Jesús-benmalad
We degi-gusad-sorba, Jesús Galilea-yalaganba bipirmakdii-gusad, ar ade yapa Judeagi gudigued, ar Judiomar e-oburgwebimalad.
Deun Judiomar-iba bato mosadgined, Obunnoged-Neg-Sobarmalad-Ibagi.
E-urbamar Jesúsga sokar: —Wegi be node, Judease be nae, adi be-sapingan be-ibmar-imaked be-dakoed.
Ar dule-wargwen na mag-dakle imakbiele, geg odukuar ibmar-imaked. Ar ibmar-dakledisulid be imakdisoggu, bela dulemar-wagab be imakdo.
E-urbamar weyob Jesúsga sogsamardo, ar ade e-urbamarse-bakar Jesús-benmalad, we Mesíasye.
Degi Jesús e-urbamarga sogdesun: —An Jerusalénse-naed-ibagan angardi amba yo moed, ar bemargardi ibagan bato gusgu guagwar-nai daed.
Ar we-napneg-naidgi-dulemar-bukmalad geg istar bemar-daked, andi istar an-dakmardo, ar andi ega sogdiid, be-ibmar-imakdimalad iskanaye.
Ar bemardi ibase namardo. Andi amba naosurgweled, ar yo angardi an-ibagan moed.
Deyob e-urbamarga sogsagu, Jesúsdi na Galileagi bessun.
Jesús Obunnoged-Neg-Sobarmalad-Ibagi gudigusad
Jesús-urbamar ibase naded-sorba, Jesús ibase nade-gusmogad. Jesús arbakee nade-gusad, emar-wagab nadsulid.
Ibagi Judiomar Jesús-amidii-guarmalad, sogdemalad: —¿Wede bia dule nade?
Agine dulemar-bukidarad-abargi Jesúsgi uurmakarmalad, gwenna-gwenna sogdemalad: “We-Jesús, dule-nuedid.” Baigandi sogmarmogad: “Suli, we dule-yardakdiid-duled.”
Ar dulemar Judiomar-dummagan-dobedba, bakar-buud Jesúsgi gwen sunmaksasurmalad.
Ar Obunnoged-Neg-Sobarmalad-Iba negabar-gusgu, Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nonikid, agi dulemar-odurdaksigusad.
Judiomar-dummagan geger Jesús-dakdemalad, sogdemalad: —Ar we-dule dummaganse-ibmar-gwen-durdaksasulid, ar degite, ¿ibiga ibmar-nue-wisi dulemar-odurdake?
Jesús amarga sogdesun: “An-ibmar-odurdaked angadsulid, Bab-Dummad-an-barmialid-sogedba an dulemar-odurdaked.
Ar Bab-Dummad-sogedba dule nanabiele, mag dakoed, an-ibmar-odurdakdiid Bab Dummadgi dani-dibe, igi, an-ibmar-odurdakdiid an na dukin onos-dibe.
Ar dule na wargwen e-sogedba ibmar sogdiile, unnila a-dule na dukin nug-dungued-amidiido. Ar e-barmialid-nug odummogega gudiirdina, adi we napiragwaddo, a-dulegine, gakan naisurdo.
“¿Ar Moisés bemarga igar uksasursi? Degite a-igargi bemar nanadisurmalad. ¿Ibiga be an-oburgwebimarsunna?”
Dulemar, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Nia begi nai. ¿Ar doamar be-oburgwebimala?
Jesús amarga sogded: “Ibmar-dakledisulid obunnoged-ibagi unnila gwennaa an imaksadde, degite ¿geger be an-dakmarde? Emide be sogmargu, an dule-iskanaye.
Moisés bemarga abgan-duku-siked-igar mesismalad. Ar Moisés bemarga uksasulindo, ar dadgan-akar-danikid. Obunnoged-ibagi bemar abgan-duku-siked-igar imakbukdo, igar-mai-inigwer, mer arbaoye.
Melle Moisés-igar-mesisadgi annaegala, amba obunnoged-iba-dibe, bemar abgan-duku-siked-igar imakbukwad, degite, ¿ibiga obunnoged-ibagi dule an nudaksad, sae be an-dakmarsunna?
Dulemar-ibmar-imaked mer askinbi be dako. Nue igar-amisadgi geb be we-dulegi sogoed, we dule-nued-dibe, igi, dule-iskana-dibe.”
¿Ar we-Jesúsde Cristo-sunnadi?
Degi Jerusalénginmalad gwenna-gwenna sogdemalad: —¿Ar dummagan we-dule-amidimarsursi, oburgwemalagar?
Emide be dakena, bela-dulemar-abargi sunmakgwisgu, degite, gwen ega akar sogsurmalad. ¿Ar dummagande nue mag itononimarsi, we, Cristo-sunnadid, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duled?
“Ar wedi anmar wisid, bia daniki, degisoggu, we-Jesús geg Cristoga gued. Ar Cristodi nonikile, anmar wisguosulid, bia danikid.”

Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dulemar-odurdaksigu, binnasur sunmakde, sogded: —Bemar mag an-dakmalad, degine, be an-wismarbalid an bialidi. An-itolegedba wargwen an danisulid, ar Bab Dummad an-barmialid, adi napiragwadid. A-duledi bemar aku-dakmalad.
Andi a-dule mag an daked, ar agi an danikid, ar a an-barmialid.
Agine, dummagan Jesús-gabi-guarmalanad, degite, bipisaale gwen gassurmalad, ar ade yo e-burgwed-ibagan omoged.

Dulemar-bukidar Jesúsgi bengussurmalad, sogdemalad: —Bab Dummad sogsad, yoedse dule-wargwen an bemarga barmidagoye. A-dule nonikile, be insagua, ¿bur-bule we-dulebali ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid imako be insae? Gwen deyob imako an insasurdo.
Fariseomar suar-ibmala-barmismalad, Jesús-gaegar
Fariseomar itosmalad, igi dulemar Jesúsgi Mesíasye sunmaknanaid. Degisoggu, Fariseomar, degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan suar-ibmala-barmismalad, Jesús-gaegar.
Geb Jesús dulemar-e-itobukwadga sogded: —Napi ichesaar an bemar-abargi gudiid, an naesokalid dule-an-barmialidse.
Be an-amimalo-inigwele, gwen be an-amimalosulid. Ar bia an gudiguoedgine, geg ase be namalad.
Degi Judiomar na ga sokarmarsun: —¿Ar wede bia naoe, anmarde bar amiosurmalad? ¿Ar wede Griego-dulemar-abargi-Judiomar-aisakis-bukmaladse naosi, Griegomar-odurdakegar?
¿Wede ibi obarsunna, we sogsad: ‘Be an-amimalo-inigwele, gwen be an-amimalosurye. Ar bia an gudiguoedgine, geg ase be namarye?’
Diwaryob Jesús E-Burba-Nued dulemarga uked
Napi-iba-naidgi, a-iba bur iba-dummadid, a-ibagi Jesús gwisgusgu, binnasur sunmakded, sogded: —Ar dule-wargwen uku-uku itodiile, anse dage, anse dii gobdado.
Ar dule an-bensulile, ar igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognai, e-ulubgi diwar-burba-nikad aryomai-guoye.

Jesús sogsa-gusad, diwar-burba nikadye, we Bab Dummad Burba Nued dulemar-egi-benguosurmalad abingaoedgi sogsa-gusad. Ar ade amba yo Bab Dummad Burba Nued nonikid, ar Jesús amba yo bela-bela e-nug ogannoleged.
Dulemar Jesúsgi emarbi binsasurmalad
Bukidar-dulemar weyob-Jesús-ibmar-soged-itosmargu, sogdemalad: —Ar we-dule, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged napiragwad-sunnadid.
Baigandi sogmalad: —We, Cristo, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-sunnadid. Degine, baiganmo sogmarmogad: —¿Ar ade Galileagi Cristode danikosi? Suli, agi daniko suli.
¿Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaisursi Cristo Davidgi danikoye, Belén-neggweburgi, bia David epenne gwalulesadgi?
Ar dulemar Jesús-ulale na muchub-muchub uludmarsunnad.
Degine, gwen-gwen Jesús-gabimalan-inigwele, gwen gassurgusmalad.
Judio-dummagan Jesús-abingassurmalad wede Cristoye
Suar-ibmala-barmilesmalad gannar nonimalad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummaganse, degi, Fariseomarse. Fariseomar ega sogdemalad: —¿Ibiga bemar Jesús-sedanisurmala?
Suar-ibmala abin-imakdemalad: —¡Dule-wargwensaale weyob gwen sunmakdisulid, nue yeer sunmaked!
Degi Fariseomar, abin-imakdemalad: —¿Ar bemar ese yardaklesmarmoga?
¿Ar bemar dakgua, dummagan, degine, Fariseomar, a-dulegi bensurmar be daksii? Benmala.
Ar dulemar-baigandi Moisés-igar-mesisad-wichurmaladba Jesúsba nagudmalad. Degisoggu, bato amar nue-ukabsales bukmarsundo.
Nicodemo, Fariseomogadi, dule ibagwengi mutik Jesússe nonigusadi, e-sordamarga sokalid:
—¿Ar anmar-igar-maidgi sunna dule-wargwenga amba yo igar-itoged-iduar bato soglesi, be dummad-nosye, degisoggu, bega sabsur odurdakleged-igar maiye? Suli, degisuli.
Fariseomar, Nicodemo-abin imakdemalad: —¿Ar be Galileaginmogadi? Bab-Dummad-Garda-narmakar-naidgi nue be baramie, be dakodo, bipisaale Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged gwen Galileagi danisulid.
((Degi dummagan na e-neg-e-negse nadmarsunnad.
